freshcache_configuration: unchanged frozen FreshCache (theta=0.40, eps 0.10/0.20/0.35, half-life risk gate)
candidate_rule: all cells of the existing 42-cell SemanticTTL validation grid whose validation search savings are at least FreshCache's validation search savings (both computed on validation by semanticttl_joint_grid_sweep.py). Both the similarity threshold theta and the TTL multiplier kappa are tunable.

quality_constraint.primary: SemanticTTL conditional WAI on the VALIDATION evidence-valid subset must be LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO frozen FreshCache's conditional WAI on the IDENTICAL request set. No slack.
quality_constraint.rationale: A slack margin would be arbitrary. The no-slack form asks the question this selection addresses directly: is there a SemanticTTL setting that is at least as safe as FreshCache on answer quality while saving more search?
quality_constraint.secondary_sensitivity: the same rule with a 5 pp slack, reported separately and never used for the headline
quality_constraint.denominator: requests whose fresh reference is CORRECT, within the validation evidence-valid subset

selection_rule.objective: among candidates satisfying the primary constraint, choose the highest VALIDATION search savings
selection_rule.if_none_satisfy: report that no configuration satisfies the constraint. The constraint is NOT relaxed after seeing results; the secondary sensitivity is reported as a separate, clearly-labelled row.

gold_verification.procedure: timestamp-validity procedure (outputs/gold_verification/timestamp_validity): expanded snapshot evidence (5,000 chars/page, no minimum-length floor, 12,000-char budget), question-type-aware prompts (AS_STATED vs CURRENT), Llama-3.1-8B + Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 breaking ties (2-of-3 MAJORITY)
gold_verification.evidence_valid_rule: (paraphrase fidelity SAME under both judges OR original base question) AND unit VALID_AT_T
gold_verification.note: VALID_AT_T is LLM-supported temporal validity, NOT independently verified factual correctness.

sample.stratification: freshness class x FreshCache serving tier, policy-neutral (strata defined before any policy is run)

generation_protocol: identical to both existing audits: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, FORCED prompt, greedy, max_new_tokens=80, 1024-token truncation, answer cut at the first '.' or newline
judging_protocol: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct + Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, chat template, greedy, max_new_tokens=6, both must agree
heldout_use: the selected configuration is replayed ONCE on the untouched held-out test split; no tuning occurs there
instantiation: quality_selection_protocol.py writes the instantiated pre-registration (this rule plus the validation reference values and the candidate list computed from the grid) to outputs/quality_selection/quality_selection_prereg.json before any answer is generated
